en: Dhammānulomapaccanīya (3), Dukapaṭṭhānapāḷi (2) 14.31. Sappītikadukādi (The Section on the Pairs Beginning with "With Rapture")
Dependent on a state accompanied by zest (*sappītika*), a state not accompanied by zest arises by way of root condition (*hetupaccaya*) ... three.
Dependent on a state not accompanied by zest, a state not not accompanied by zest arises by way of root condition.
Under root [condition], there are nine ... pe ... under prenascence and repetition, there are six ... pe ... under non-disappearance, there are nine.
Dependent on a state accompanied by rapture (*pītisahagata*), a state not accompanied by rapture arises by way of the root condition (*hetupaccaya*)... three.
Dependent on a state not accompanied by rapture, a state not not accompanied by rapture arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Under the root condition there are nine... pe ...
under the prenascence and repetition conditions there are six... pe ... under the non-disappearance condition there are nine.
Dependent on a state accompanied by pleasure (*sukhasahagata*), a state not accompanied by pleasure arises by way of root condition (*hetupaccaya*) … three.
Dependent on a state not accompanied by pleasure, a state not not accompanied by pleasure arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.
Under root [condition] there are nine … pe … under prenascence and repetition there are six … pe … under non-disappearance there are nine.
Dependent on a state accompanied by equanimity, a state not accompanied by equanimity arises by way of root condition … three.
Dependent on a state not accompanied by equanimity, a state not not accompanied by equanimity arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.
In the case of root, there are nine … pe … in the case of prenascence and repetition, there are six … pe … in the case of non-disappearance, there are nine.
